name: investment-os
description: A rules-first long-term investment agent distributed as one canonical skill with fresh authoritative runtime state.

interface.longDescription: Use one canonical Investment OS skill in ChatGPT or Codex to review a live portfolio, make policy-grounded investment judgments, separate research from Production, and keep broker execution under explicit owner authority. Interactive Brokers is used only as an authoritative runtime capability; the repository stores rules, never portfolio data.
defaultPrompt: Review my monthly funding under Investment OS.
